verdict.rationale: Productboard's first-party docs say you can 'reschedule an initiative' and 'move an initiative to a new release' through its MCP server and agents, and the server can create and update initiatives and releases. Release groups also let separate teams run their own release systems. However, all of this evidence describes agent-driven actions, so the in-app workflow is not shown. Missing for 10: documentation of rescheduling and drag-and-drop between releases in the in-app roadmap UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
